brief:
Youths from the village of Farkha resisted an attack by settlers and recovered a herd of sheep west of the village, the Ma'an news agency reported. The confrontation occurred as settlers attempted to seize the livestock in the area.

Details of casualties or injuries were not immediately available. The incident is the latest in a series of clashes between Palestinian residents and Israeli settlers in the occupied West Bank.
title: Farkha youth repel settler attack, recover sheep herd
